title: A look at the AI community's "handoverism" ideas, which envision humanity entrusting "the direction of its future to AI", and what it may look like in practice (Ruxandra Teslo/Ruxandra's Substack)
summary: Ruxandra Teslo / Ruxandra's Substack: A look at the AI community's “handoverism” ideas, which envision humanity entrusting “the direction of its future to AI”, and what it may look like in practice — Even the optimistic visions of a post-AGI future leave little room for human self-determination
contentText:
Ruxandra Teslo / Ruxandra's Substack :

A look at the AI community's “handoverism” ideas, which envision humanity entrusting “the direction of its future to AI”, and what it may look like in practice   —  Even the optimistic visions of a post-AGI future leave little room for human self-determination
